name: himalaya-mcp
description: Privacy-first email for Claude via the himalaya CLI. List, search, read, triage, compose, and manage emails without sending credentials to the cloud.

himalaya_binary.title: Himalaya Binary
himalaya_binary.description: Path to himalaya CLI binary. Leave empty to use the system PATH (requires: brew install himalaya).

himalaya_account.title: Default Account
himalaya_account.description: Default email account name (as configured in himalaya). Leave empty to use the default account.

himalaya_folder.title: Default Folder
himalaya_folder.description: Default email folder to operate on.

tools.name: list_emails
tools.description: List emails in a folder. Returns envelope data: subject, from, date, flags.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search emails using himalaya filter syntax. Examples: 'subject invoice', 'from paypal', 'subject meeting and from boss'. Operators: and, or, not. Conditions: subject, from, to, body, date, before, after, flag.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read an email message body (plain text). Use the ID from list_emails or search_emails.

tools.name: read_email_html
tools.description: Read an email message body as HTML. Useful for formatted emails.

tools.name: read_email_raw
tools.description: Read the raw MIME source of an email. Returns the full, unedited message including all headers. Useful for debugging and email forensics.

tools.name: render_email
tools.description: Read an email body rendered as clean markdown. For HTML emails, converts to markdown for a clean reading experience. For plain text emails, returns the body as-is.

tools.name: flag_email
tools.description: Add or remove flags on an email. Common flags: Seen, Flagged, Answered, Deleted, Draft. Use 'add' to set flags, 'remove' to clear them.

tools.name: get_unread_count
tools.description: Get the number of unread emails in a folder. Uses himalaya's server-side filter for fast counting even in large mailboxes.

tools.name: move_email
tools.description: Move an email to a different folder. Common targets: Archive, Trash, Spam, Sent, Drafts.

tools.name: draft_reply
tools.description: Generate a reply draft for an email. Returns the reply template with headers and quoted original message. Does NOT send -- use send_email to send after user reviews.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email template. SAFETY: requires confirm=true to actually send. Without confirm, returns a preview. Always show the user the preview and get their approval before sending with confirm=true.

tools.name: snooze_email
tools.description: Snooze an email until a specified time. Supports ISO dates and shorthand: 2h, 1d, tomorrow, monday.

tools.name: compose_email
tools.description: Compose and send a new email (not a reply). SAFETY: requires confirm=true to actually send. Without confirm, returns a preview for user review.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List all email folders/mailboxes for an account. Returns folder names.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new email folder/mailbox.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a reminder in Apple Reminders (macOS only). Use for action items, follow-ups, and tasks extracted from email.

tools.name: delete_folder
tools.description: Delete an email folder/mailbox. SAFETY: requires confirm=true to actually delete. Without confirm, returns a preview warning.

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: List attachments for an email message. Downloads all attachments to inspect them, then returns filename, MIME type (inferred from extension), and size for each.

tools.name: download_attachment
tools.description: Download an email attachment to a temporary directory. Downloads all attachments, then returns the path to the requested file.

tools.name: extract_calendar_event
tools.description: Extract calendar event details from an email's ICS attachment. Downloads all attachments, finds the .ics file, parses it, and returns event summary, dates, location, and organizer.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Create an event in Apple Calendar. SAFETY: requires confirm=true to actually create. Without confirm, returns a preview. macOS only.

tools.name: export_to_markdown
tools.description: Export an email as formatted markdown with YAML frontmatter (date, from, to, subject, flags). Returns the markdown text.

tools.name: create_action_item
tools.description: Read an email and extract action items, todos, deadlines, and commitments. Returns structured action items that can be used to create tasks, reminders, or calendar events.

tools.name: list_snoozed_emails
tools.description: List all snoozed emails. Shows active snoozes (not yet expired) and expired snoozes ready to revisit.

tools.name: list_starred
tools.description: List all flagged/starred emails. Returns envelopes with flag, subject, sender, and date. Uses server-side filtering for fast results.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List email threads (conversations) in a folder. Groups related emails by subject line. Returns threads sorted by most recent activity, with participant list and message count.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read all messages in a conversation thread. Given a thread_id (the ID of the first message), fetches all related messages and returns them in chronological order. Use list_threads first to get thread IDs.

tools.name: copy_to_clipboard
tools.description: Copy text to the system clipboard (pbcopy on macOS, xclip on Linux). Useful for copying email content, markdown exports, or any text.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check himalaya-mcp installation health and per-account IMAP connectivity. Returns overall status (healthy/degraded/broken) and a per-account detail array. Use when an email tool fails to diagnose which accounts are reachable.

prompts.name: triage_inbox
prompts.description: Classify recent emails as actionable, FYI, or skip. Suggests flags and folder moves.
prompts.text: Triage my recent emails. For each email, classify as Actionable, FYI, or Skip, and suggest flags or folder moves.

prompts.name: summarize_email
prompts.description: Produce a one-sentence summary and list action items for a specific email.
prompts.text: Summarize the specified email with a one-sentence summary, action items, and priority level.

prompts.name: daily_email_digest
prompts.description: Create a markdown digest of today's important emails, grouped by priority.
prompts.text: Create a daily email digest grouped by priority: Requires Action, FYI/Review, and Low Priority.

prompts.name: draft_reply
prompts.description: Compose a professional reply to an email. Reads the original, generates a draft, and presents for review before sending.
prompts.text: Help me compose a professional reply to the specified email. Show the draft for review before sending.

prompts.name: morning_briefing
prompts.description: Comprehensive morning email briefing with urgency classification, calendar events, and action items.
prompts.text: Give me a morning email briefing with urgency classification, calendar events, and action items.

prompts.name: inbox_check
prompts.description: Quick inbox status check with unread count, highlights, and suggested next actions.
prompts.text: Quick check on my inbox with unread count, flagged highlights, and suggested next actions.

prompts.name: weekly_email_digest
prompts.description: Create a markdown digest of this week's important emails, grouped by priority and day.
prompts.text: Create a weekly email digest grouping emails by day and priority.
